description.value: Combine officers, Dixie riders, and Choir cantors alike know your name as someone who walks between flags and comes back alive. Once per day, you can attempt a single Diplomacy check to negotiate a temporary, binding ceasefire between two factions present, treating your proficiency rank as one step higher for that check alone.

cinderfall.incomplete: 'Treating your proficiency rank as one step higher for that check alone' has no confirmed rule-element shape -- the real ActiveEffectLike path for proficiency rank (system.skills.<skill>.rank) is a permanent state change via 'upgrade' mode, not a temporary bump scoped to a single once-per-day check.
